properties.text: P256VERIFY precompile must never revert regardless of input (except out-of-gas).
properties.assertion: forall input: p256verify(input) => (returns_result OR returns_empty) AND NOT reverts

properties.text: P256VERIFY gas cost is fixed at 6900 regardless of input or execution path.
properties.assertion: forall input, outcome: gas_consumed(p256verify(input)) == 6900

properties.text: P256VERIFY output is exactly 32 bytes (0x01 padded) on success or 0 bytes on failure.
properties.assertion: forall input: len(p256verify(input)) == 32 XOR len(p256verify(input)) == 0

properties.text: Input must be exactly 160 bytes; shorter or longer input must return empty.
properties.assertion: forall input: len(input) != 160 => p256verify(input) == empty

properties.text: Signature scalars r and s must satisfy 0 < r < n and 0 < s < n before verification.
properties.assertion: forall (h,r,s,qx,qy): verify(h,r,s,qx,qy) => 0 < r < SECP256R1_N AND 0 < s < SECP256R1_N

properties.text: Public key coordinates qx, qy must satisfy 0 <= qx < p and 0 <= qy < p.
properties.assertion: forall (qx,qy): point_valid(qx,qy) => 0 <= qx < SECP256R1_P AND 0 <= qy < SECP256R1_P

properties.text: Public key (qx, qy) must lie on secp256r1 curve: qy^2 == qx^3 + a*qx + b (mod p).
properties.assertion: forall (qx,qy): point_valid(qx,qy) => qy^2 mod p == (qx^3 + a*qx + b) mod p

properties.text: Public key (qx, qy) must not be the point at infinity (0, 0).
properties.assertion: forall (qx,qy): point_valid(qx,qy) => NOT (qx == 0 AND qy == 0)

properties.text: R' point-at-infinity check is required; skipping it enables signature forgery (RIP-7212 fix).
properties.assertion: forall (h,r,s,qx,qy): R' = u1*G + u2*Q => (R' == INF => return false)

properties.text: Final comparison must use r' == r (mod n), not direct equality (RIP-7212 fix).
properties.assertion: forall verify: compare(r', r) => r' mod n == r mod n

properties.text: Modular inverse s^(-1) must be computed modulo subgroup order n, not field modulus p.
properties.assertion: forall s: s_inv = mod_inverse(s, SECP256R1_N) AND NOT mod_inverse(s, SECP256R1_P)

properties.text: Scalar multiplications and point addition must use secp256r1 curve parameters, not secp256k1.
properties.assertion: forall ecops: curve_params(ecmul, ecadd) == SECP256R1_PARAMS

properties.text: Input fields decoded as five 32-byte BigEndian unsigned integers from positions [0..160].
properties.assertion: forall input: decode(input) == (BE(input[0:32]), BE(input[32:64]), BE(input[64:96]), BE(input[96:128]), BE(input[128:160]))

properties.text: Field bounds check must use field modulus p for coordinates, not subgroup order n.
properties.assertion: forall (qx,qy): bounds_check(qx) uses SECP256R1_P AND bounds_check(qy) uses SECP256R1_P

properties.text: Invalid inputs must consume same gas (6900) as valid verification; no early gas refund.
properties.assertion: forall input: gas_consumed(p256verify(input)) == 6900 regardless of validation_outcome

properties.text: Transaction callers can supply arbitrary input to P256VERIFY; all inputs must be validated.
properties.assertion: forall caller, input: p256verify(input) => input_validation(input) executed before crypto_ops

properties.text: Validation checks must execute in defined order: length, r, s, qx, qy, curve, infinity.
properties.assertion: forall input: validation_order == [len_check, r_bounds, s_bounds, qx_bounds, qy_bounds, curve_eq, inf_check]

properties.text: Blob commitment count must not exceed get_blob_parameters(epoch).max_blobs_per_block.
properties.assertion: forall block: len(block.body.blob_kzg_commitments) <= get_blob_parameters(epoch).max_blobs_per_block

properties.text: Execution payload parent_hash must chain to state.latest_execution_payload_header.block_hash.
properties.assertion: forall payload: payload.parent_hash == state.latest_execution_payload_header.block_hash

properties.text: Execution payload prev_randao must match get_randao_mix(state, current_epoch).
properties.assertion: forall payload: payload.prev_randao == get_randao_mix(state, get_current_epoch(state))

properties.text: Execution payload timestamp must equal compute_time_at_slot(state, state.slot).
properties.assertion: forall payload: payload.timestamp == compute_time_at_slot(state, state.slot)

properties.text: BLOB_SCHEDULE entries must have unique epoch values to ensure deterministic parameter lookup.
properties.assertion: forall i,j: i != j => BLOB_SCHEDULE[i].epoch != BLOB_SCHEDULE[j].epoch

properties.text: All BLOB_SCHEDULE max_blobs_per_block values must not exceed MAX_BLOB_COMMITMENTS_PER_BLOCK.
properties.assertion: forall entry in BLOB_SCHEDULE: entry.max_blobs_per_block <= MAX_BLOB_COMMITMENTS_PER_BLOCK

properties.text: All BLOB_SCHEDULE epoch values must be >= FULU_FORK_EPOCH.
properties.assertion: forall entry in BLOB_SCHEDULE: entry.epoch >= FULU_FORK_EPOCH

properties.text: get_blob_parameters defaults to ELECTRA parameters when no schedule entry matches.
properties.assertion: forall epoch: no_match(BLOB_SCHEDULE, epoch) => get_blob_parameters(epoch) == BlobParameters(ELECTRA)

properties.text: Fork digest must incorporate blob parameters via XOR; different blob configs produce different digests.
properties.assertion: forall e1,e2: blob_params(e1) != blob_params(e2) => fork_digest(e1) != fork_digest(e2)

properties.text: Fork digest result must be truncated to exactly 4 bytes for domain separation.
properties.assertion: forall digest: len(compute_fork_digest(epoch)) == 4

properties.text: compute_proposer_indices must produce exactly SLOTS_PER_EPOCH proposer indices.
properties.assertion: forall epoch: len(compute_proposer_indices(state, epoch, seed, indices)) == SLOTS_PER_EPOCH

properties.text: All proposer indices returned must be from the active validator set for that epoch.
properties.assertion: forall idx in proposer_indices: idx in get_active_validator_indices(state, epoch)

properties.text: get_beacon_proposer_index must use pre-calculated proposer_lookahead, not on-demand computation.
properties.assertion: forall slot: get_beacon_proposer_index(state) == state.proposer_lookahead[slot % SLOTS_PER_EPOCH]

properties.text: Only active validators are eligible for proposer selection via DOMAIN_BEACON_PROPOSER seed.
properties.assertion: forall epoch: proposer_seed(epoch) == get_seed(state, epoch, DOMAIN_BEACON_PROPOSER)

properties.text: All 15 epoch sub-processes must execute in strict sequential order; reordering is invalid.
properties.assertion: forall epoch_transition: execution_order == [just, inact, rewards, registry, slash, eth1, deposits, consol, balance, slash_reset, randao, hist, part, sync, lookahead]

properties.text: process_proposer_lookahead must be the final step in epoch processing (EIP-7917).
properties.assertion: forall epoch: process_epoch(state).last_step == process_proposer_lookahead

properties.text: After process_proposer_lookahead, lookahead length remains (MIN_SEED_LOOKAHEAD+1)*SLOTS_PER_EPOCH.
properties.assertion: forall state': len(state'.proposer_lookahead) == (MIN_SEED_LOOKAHEAD + 1) * SLOTS_PER_EPOCH

properties.text: Lookahead shift removes exactly SLOTS_PER_EPOCH entries from the front of the array.
properties.assertion: forall state, state': state'.proposer_lookahead[0:len-SPE] == state.proposer_lookahead[SPE:]

properties.text: New proposers computed for epoch N+MIN_SEED_LOOKAHEAD+1 at epoch N boundary.
properties.assertion: forall epoch N: new_proposers == get_beacon_proposer_indices(state, N + MIN_SEED_LOOKAHEAD + 1)

properties.text: Engine API is JWT-authenticated; verify_and_notify_new_payload requires valid JWT.
properties.assertion: forall caller: execution_engine.verify_and_notify_new_payload(req) => caller.has_valid_jwt == true

properties.text: P2P peers are untrusted; all block fields must be fully validated before state mutation.
properties.assertion: forall block from P2P: validate(block) executed before apply_state_transition(block)

properties.text: Blob parameters in fork digest ensure nodes with different configs form separate networks.
properties.assertion: forall node_a, node_b: blob_params(a) != blob_params(b) => network(a) != network(b)

properties.text: Proposer lookahead depends on correct randao mixes and active validator set at epoch boundary.
properties.assertion: forall epoch: proposer_lookahead(epoch) deterministic given state.randao_mixes AND state.validators

properties.text: Execution engine must validate and accept payload before CL caches the execution payload header.
properties.assertion: forall payload: cache_header(payload) => execution_engine.verify_and_notify_new_payload(payload) == true

properties.text: After processing execution payload, state.latest_execution_payload_header is updated to new header.
properties.assertion: forall state': state'.latest_execution_payload_header.block_hash == payload.block_hash

properties.text: Proposer lookahead for epoch N+1 must be available at start of epoch N.
properties.assertion: forall epoch N, slot in N+1: state.proposer_lookahead contains proposer for slot

properties.text: State mutations from earlier epoch sub-processes must be visible to later sub-processes.
properties.assertion: forall step_i, step_j: i < j => state_after(step_i) == state_input(step_j)
